name: Diamond
description: A diamond, the priced material component of SRD 5.1 spells (Revivify: diamonds worth 300 gp, which the spell consumes; Raise Dead: a diamond worth at least 500 gp; Greater Restoration: diamond dust worth at least 100 gp). The SRD equipment tables list no gems, so the item has no list price or weight: each character@4 equipment[] entry carries its own value_gp.
